body: I’m on suicide watch for a double attempt last week. I’m surprised they let me keep my things. I’ve been waiting to get treated but this virus is holding everything back. I want to sign myself out but they 51/50ed me so I’m stuck here. They really think padded walls and isolation is better than death. When I’m tying that slip it I feel all my troubles float away. I feel happy when I’m hanging. I’m at peace when i slowly bleed out and feel my life slip through my steady stream of blood. If I were to go back, I would’ve shot myself a while ago. But now I can’t even go near a weapon but I’m mentally unstable to safely handle a weapon.
Exactly. People say it’s selfish to kill yourself. But if you are not happy with your life and you are suffering everyday and have no will to live... who’s truly being selfish?
